rungs.title: Statements of record: the Hodge conjecture, Lefschetz (1,1) and the low-dimension case, as stated upstream
rungs.note: Pinned at upstream commit 2ead713 (Lean and Mathlib v4.35.0-rc4). Sorry-free definitions, no axioms; this repository proves things about them and never restates them.

rungs.title: Lefschetz (1,1) and the low-dimension variant are instances of the upstream Hodge conjecture
rungs.note: Definitional consistency check: the variants use the same objects as the main statement, with no cast or reindexing.

rungs.title: Independent build and axiom audit of the upstream Lefschetz (1,1) proof (PR #228 head c7d5c94b)
rungs.note: Upstream claims a green build of 5,814 jobs and only the three standard axioms, on Lean and Mathlib v4.33.1. Done when reproduced here and recorded in docs/sketches/lefschetz-1-1-upstream.md together with the red-team verdict.

rungs.title: Non-vacuity tests for the upstream definitions: a variety satisfying the hypotheses, a nonzero class in H^2, a nonzero cycle class
rungs.note: Rules out a definitional accident that would make Lefschetz (1,1) or the conjecture trivially true. Exact list from the red-team audit of the upstream proof; contributed upstream to Other/ where upstream wants it.

rungs.title: Port the upstream Lefschetz (1,1) stack from v4.33.1 to the current upstream pin
rungs.note: Stack: upstream PRs #217-#226, #9, #230 (Oka proper GAGA, 372 modules), #228. Contributed upstream; coordinate with the upstream authors before starting, since upstream proposed taking Oka as a dependency instead of vendoring it.

rungs.title: Lefschetz (1,1): the upstream LefschetzOneOne, checked at this repository's pin
rungs.note: The checkpoint. Done when `theorem : LefschetzOneOne` passes tools/check.py here, the red-team verdict is pass, and the conventions register is filled. Then take the Markman inventory.

rungs.title: Hard Lefschetz for the upstream rational cohomology of a smooth projective variety
rungs.note: Needs Kähler geometry and the Lefschetz decomposition on the upstream cohomology; large. Upstream and Tau Ceti have partial material; inventory before posting sub-rungs.

rungs.title: The upstream HodgeConjectureInDimensionLE 3
rungs.note: Codimension 0, 1, n-1, n; the middle cases come from Lefschetz (1,1) and hard Lefschetz (Shioda1983, daSilva2021).

rungs.title: Markman's theorem as a solved-research statement on upstream definitions: Weil classes on abelian fourfolds of Weil type are algebraic
rungs.note: Front abelian. Deferred until the Lefschetz checkpoint (decision 0003); the inventory of tools and gaps comes from that checkpoint. Source Markman2025 is a preprint; the statement records that.

rungs.title: Cycles of pure codimension p and the group Z^p(X)
rungs.note: Superseded (decision 0003) by upstream codimensionCycleSubgroup (Other/AlgebraicGeometry/Cycle/Codimension.lean). Module removed; two lemmas without an upstream counterpart (codimension one equals Mathlib weilDivisors; distinct codimensions meet in zero) are offered upstream.

rungs.title: Rational equivalence of cycles and the Chow group CH^p(X)
rungs.note: Not needed (decision 0003): the upstream statement uses the span of subvariety classes, not Chow groups. Covered elsewhere by Tau Ceti Chow.RatEquiv and Mathlib PR #38472.
